speaker_map.description: A list mapping segment_id to the inferred speaker name.

roles.description: A list mapping inferred speaker name to their role.

buying_signals.description: A list of meaningful positive buying or interest signals from the Candidate/Customer (e.g. explicit interest, asking about next steps, discussing timeline, strong positive intent). Do NOT include generic positive statements.

objections.description: A list of genuine, contextual objections raised during the conversation (e.g. price/budget, timing, technical limitations, lack of authority, uncertainty). Ignore generic negative sentiment that is not a concrete objection.

objection.description: The category or brief summary of the objection (e.g. 'Price', 'Timing').

quote.description: The verbatim quote from the transcript illustrating the objection.

speaker.description: The raw speaker ID of the person raising the objection.

objection_handling.description: An analysis of how the Interviewer/Host handled each genuine objection.

speaker.description: The speaker ID who raised the objection.

handled.description: Whether the interviewer attempted to handle the objection.

handling_evidence.description: Brief evidence or explanation of why it was handled effectively, partially, or poorly.

handling_quote.description: Optional verbatim quote from the interviewer demonstrating how they handled it.
